source: read-only SQL observations of AevPath US production flight_jobs/flight_captures columns; AevPath-derived test records only, no raw_capture payloads or provider response files

event.attribution: Potentially impacted; no per-flight causality established

notes: Source snapshots reflect different last capture times, not a synchronized current-time feed.
A filed canonical route does not guarantee Chester schema READY validation or eligibility to sell.
No post-flight accuracy score or actual aircraft position is inferred.

When the original scheduled gate-out has passed and there is neither a confirmed actual_out nor a recent future estimated_out, fail closed rather than showing SELLABLE; treat expected sale state below as a test requirement, not an already deployed endpoint behaviour.
check_again_after is a policy-generated retry time, not a field sourced from FlightAware.

cases.test: Successive delay revisions; defer sale until complete validated derived package exists, recheck time must be in future
Ground-stop-window delay, no false DEPARTED solely because scheduled time passed
Originally scheduled before event, observed delayed during event; refresh stale estimated departure
Delay observed; future recheck or fail closed after estimate becomes stale
Potential stale departure time. Do not treat route availability as sufficient to declare SELLABLE when estimate is past and status is old.
Observed scheduled status persisted after scheduled departure. Force cautious recheck and no sale without recent confirmed package state.
